From the first derivation they get the meaning disciples by saying that a disciple means a helper, and so means one to whom one turns for help (cf. ath-Thaʚlabī, Qisˢasˢ, 273). The other, however, is the more popular explanation, and the disciples are said to have been called because they were fullers whose profession was to clean clothes, or because they wore white clothing, or because of the purity of their inward life (cf.
